name: zero-to-prod/sdk
description: Template for a framework-agnostic PHP SDK generated from an OpenAPI document

suggest.illuminate/http: Required when using the Laravel Http transport
suggest.symfony/yaml: Required to generate from a YAML OpenAPI document (ext-yaml also works)
suggest.zero-to-prod/data-model-generator: Required to regenerate models from an OpenAPI document

scripts-descriptions.check: Run all checks (tests, PHPStan, CS Fixer, Rector, template, route + link annotations, CLAUDE.md, README)
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply all fixes (Rector, CS Fixer, generated annotations and docs) then re-check
scripts-descriptions.test: Run tests for the PHP version set in .env
scripts-descriptions.test-all: Run tests for all PHP versions
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan static analysis at level 9
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHP CS Fixer in dry-run mode (no changes)
scripts-descriptions.format: Run PHP CS Fixer and apply fixes
scripts-descriptions.rector-lint: Run Rector in dry-run mode (no changes)
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Generate code coverage report for src/
scripts-descriptions.coverage-api: Generate code coverage report for public API classes only
scripts-descriptions.check-template: Verify the template ancestry wiring (template remote, keepours driver, lockfiles)
scripts-descriptions.check-routes: Verify @method PHPDoc on ApiRoute matches #[HasRoute] cases
scripts-descriptions.check-api-methods: Verify @method PHPDoc on SdkApi matches #[AdminApi] attributes
scripts-descriptions.check-links: Verify @link annotations exist on model classes and ApiRoute cases
scripts-descriptions.check-claude-md: Verify CLAUDE.md CLI commands section is up-to-date
scripts-descriptions.check-readme: Verify README.md public API section is up to date
scripts-descriptions.check-toc: Verify README.md Table of Contents section is up-to-date
scripts-descriptions.generate-sdk: Generate src/Models and src/ApiRoute.php from the OpenAPI document in sdk.json
scripts-descriptions.generate-routes: Generate @method PHPDoc on ApiRoute enum from #[HasRoute] cases
scripts-descriptions.generate-api-methods: Generate @method PHPDoc on SdkApi from #[AdminApi] attributes
scripts-descriptions.generate-links: Generate @link annotations on model classes and ApiRoute cases
scripts-descriptions.generate-claude-md: Generate CLI commands section in CLAUDE.md from the composer.json scripts
scripts-descriptions.generate-readme: Generate public API section in README.md from the package CLI
scripts-descriptions.generate-toc: Generate Table of Contents section in README.md from ##/###/#### headings
scripts-descriptions.deps: Run a composer command for the PHP version set in .env
scripts-descriptions.deps-all: Run a composer command for all PHP versions
scripts-descriptions.setup: Initialize project: copy .env.example and pull doc repos
scripts-descriptions.new-package: Print the command sequence for creating a derived SDK package
